headerDocs.name: X-API-Key

toolsPreview.name: structure_text
toolsPreview.description: Convert messy text to strict JSON schema. Use for emails, chat logs, unstructured input. Schemas: invoice, receipt, contact, resume.

toolsPreview.name: parse_invoice
toolsPreview.description: Parse invoice text into vendor, amount, due_date, line_items (with math_check).

toolsPreview.name: extract_table
toolsPreview.description: Extract HTML or markdown tables into JSON rows.

toolsPreview.name: normalize_data
toolsPreview.description: Normalize data object to a named schema (invoice, receipt, contact, resume).

toolsPreview.name: validate_structure
toolsPreview.description: Validate JSON against a schema. Enforces field presence and types (string/number/date/array).

toolsPreview.name: get_schema
toolsPreview.description: Discover schema shapes. Pass name for one schema, or omit to list all curated schemas.
